en.quote: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
en.speaker: Isaac

he.quote: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּנִּי מִי אַתָּה בְּנִֽי
he.speaker: יצחק

en.18: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

he.18: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִי וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֶּנִּי מִי אַתָּה בְּנִֽי׃

en.quote: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
en.riddle: Art thou my very son Esau?
en.speaker: Isaac

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו וַיֹּאמֶר אָֽנִי
he.speaker: יצחק

en.24: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.

he.24: וַיֹּאמֶר אַתָּה זֶה בְּנִי עֵשָׂו וַיֹּאמֶר אָֽנִי׃

en.quote: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
en.speaker: Isaac

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יִצְחָק אָבִיו מִי־אָתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי בִּנְךָ בְכֹֽרְךָ עֵשָֽׂו
he.speaker: יִצְחָק

en.32: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
